description: This file defines the NoViableAltException class, which extends RecognitionException, as part of an error handling mechanism in a parser generated by ANTLR. It includes properties for decision details and a constructor for initialization, along with a string representation method.

classes.name: NoViableAltException
classes.description: Defines a specific exception thrown when no viable alternative is found during parsing in ANTLR-generated PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of NoViableAltException with decision details and input context.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, indicating the unexpected token and decision context.
